{"body": "## Problem

`metrics.py` reports issue to release as one number (`issue_to_release_median`, `issue_to_release_p90`, spec 027), so a retro can say G-1 is missed but not where the time went. Finding that out today takes a hand-written GraphQL query.

## Success

- metrics.py reports issue to release split into stages, each with median and p90: issue to the first agent comment, issue to PR opened, PR opened to merged, merged to the first release that holds the merge commit
- Issue to PR opened is reported separately for issues filed by a person and by the App
- The retro names the stage that grew most when a lead-time measure is missed
- The stage metrics join the spec 027 registry, so a goal can set a measure on one stage

## Notes

- Lead time for changes and issue to release already exist (#56, spec 027); this only breaks the second into stages
- The numbers in #830 were computed this way by hand
- Forge data only, like every metric in the registry
", "comments": [], "labels": [], "state": "OPEN", "title": "Issue to release by stage in metrics.py"}
